events.name: An Intimate Evening with Tamar Braxton & Friends
events.info: Tamar Braxton returns to the stage for a special engagement, bringing her unmistakable voice, magnetic presence, and chart-topping catalog to audiences this summer. An unforgettable force in entertainment since emerging in 2000, Tamar has captivated fans around the world with her powerhouse vocals, candid personality, and dynamic artistry.An EMMY and GRAMMY-nominated singer, actress, television personality, and producer, Tamar continues to evolve while remaining true to the passion and authenticity that have defined her career. As she embraces what she calls her Me Year, she is reclaiming her voice, celebrating personal growth, and entering an exciting new chapter across music, television, and film. Fans can expect an evening filled with soulful performances, fan favorites, and the signature charisma that has made her one of the most recognizable voices in R&B.Join us for an unforgettable night with Tamar Braxton as she shares her music, her journey, and her undeniable star power in this intimate concert setting.

events.info: Celebrate the 10th anniversary of My Hero Academia with a heart-pounding concert event powered by the explosive energy of its iconic soundtrack! This anniversary tour is one of the major celebrations honoring a decade of Plus Ultra storytelling. Feel the adrenaline as the most unforgettable scenes from the series burst onto a massive screen, perfectly synced with a world-class live band bringing Yuki Hayashi?s score roaring to life. Every riff, beat, melody and iconic character quotes from the original voice cast, cranks up the triumph, heartbreak, and heroism. Delivering an electrifying, full-throttle experience unlike anything fans have ever seen. Celebrate the world of heroes through music DOORS open at 6:00 PM. SHOW starts at 7:00 PM. For general ticketing and event questions, please contact the Warner Box Office at WarnerBoxOffice@LiveNation.com. For Premium Seating information, please reach out to Maryclaire Griffin at MaryclaireGriffin@LiveNation.com or call 202-626-8255.
